sketch.name: ForwardCurveChart
sketch.description: A commodity forward curve by contract month: the curve with a dashed prior curve to show the shift, the hedged price per month as markers and the hedged volume as faint columns, with the front-month price and its change in the header.

props.name: title
props.description: The curve's name, shown in the header.

props.name: unit
props.description: The price unit shown after the title.

props.name: volumeUnit
props.description: The unit of the hedged volume, shown in the legend and tooltip.

props.name: showPrior
props.description: Shows the prior curve as a dashed line.

props.name: points
props.description: The curve by contract month, nearest first: { month, price, priorPrice, hedgedPrice, hedgedVolume }; 0 hedged means none.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no items or collections): points are data rows (ForwardCurvePoint). Chart drawn as SVG in real pixels, redrawn on resize, so it stays crisp from ~300x200 to ~1000x500 inside a GridBoard widget (no card chrome). Prior curve dashed (muted), hedged price as short green ticks, hedged volume as faint accent columns on a secondary scale (max column = 38% of plot height). Tooltip on hover; click fires monthSelected { month } and the server sets Selected to that month. Colours follow the GridKrafter palette (same tokens as CrushMarginGauge).
